title: Lack of minimum deposited amount can result in bad debt
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `PositionManager` contract, the `deposit()` function allows users to deposit assets into any supported vault with no minimum deposit size. This enables the creation of very small deposit positions, referred to as "dust deposits", where these small deposits can then be used as collateral to borrow against them.
